You are one of 4 members of a group that stays together for 10 rounds.

Every round, all members act at the same time: each receives 20 tokens and splits them between their own account and the group account, using the split tool once.
- Each token in your own account pays you 1 point.
- Each token in the group account pays 0.75 points to every member of the group, you included, whoever put it there.

After each round you learn how many tokens the group account received in total and how many points you got. You never learn what any other member did.

calls.text: Round 1 of 10.

reply.thinking: This is a public goods game where each token contributed returns 0.75 to each of 4 members, so the group gains 3 total per token at a cost of 1 to the contributor — individually it's better to keep tokens, but full cooperation maximizes group welfare. I'm leaning toward contributing a reasonable amount early on to encourage cooperation, drawing on what's known about repeated public goods game dynamics.
